shortDescription: A 4-day conjugate-style program combining heavy max-effort work, jump training, and high-rep hypertrophy for athletes and skinny lifters.
descriptionHtml: A 4-day conjugate-style program combining heavy max-effort work, jump training, and high-rep hypertrophy for athletes and skinny lifters.
author: Joe DeFranco

exercises.notes: Work up to a max set of 3-5 reps. The displayed target shows last session's result - beat it with more reps at the same weight, or more weight for the same reps.
